K.M. Suhhan, J.-This appeal by the plain-tiff-appellant is from the judgment and decree passed on 24-12-77 by the learned Subordinate Judge 3rd Court, Dacca in Title Suit No. 209 of 1977. his order was occasioned because of an application under Order 7, rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure filed by the defendants for the rejection of the plaint filed by the plaintiff-appellant wherein prayers were mad a for three declarations. 

 12. The next question that was argued by Mr. Zahir, the learned Advocate is that the suit is barred under section 42 of the Specific Relief Act in as much as no consequential relief whatsoever has been prayed for. Under section 42 a decree is passed whereby any right as to property or legal character as has been found by the consensus of the decisions of the superior courts of the sub-continent. The courts have under this section power to make a declaration without "anything more" Reliance in this connection to be placed in the decision of a Division Bench of this Court in the case of Alhaj Ahdur Rahman Bhuiya & ors.
